newsitem.title: USA: Cycomm International names Skoff CFO.
newsitem.headline: Cycomm International names Skoff CFO.

text.p: Cycomm International Inc said Friday it has named Michael Skoff chief financial officer.

Skoff is a managing director of Corstone Corp, a private company specializing in the telecommunications and information technology. He has also been with Cycomm as an independent consultant and interim chief financial officer for the most recent 18 months.
The company also said it has named Laurie Rice as director of corporate communications, responsible for internal corporate communication as well investor relations.

Cycomm also said that it will change the end of its fiscal year to Dec 31, from May 31, to conform with industry practice, facilitate future analyst coverage, and correspond to the fiscal year of its largest subsidiary.
Cycomm makes information technology products, including computers and computing systems, wireless and cellular devices, secure communications products and other telecommunications services.
